messages:
olivia (pm): Quick callout — we need final decisions for the embeddings endpoint launch matrix: tenant QoS, batching defaults, response shape, and what gets gated for Private. Need owners and acceptance criteria by EOD.
kevin (eng-ml): Runtime proposal: three model SKUs: rdw-embed-128 (cheap), rdw-embed-1536 (balanced, default), rdw-embed-4096 (high-capacity). Defaults: Hosted pools default max_batch_size = 256; Dedicated default = 512 but tenant-configurable up to an operator cap. Keep batching logic item-based, not token-based, for embeddings.
mohit (eng-platform): Platform constraints: add concurrent_batches_per_tenant cap = 3 to avoid memory OOMs. Rate-limiting should be expressed in items/sec per tenant. Also need per-request payload size cap — suggest 1MB by default (configurable per deployment).
claire (product): Response contract proposal: top-level keys: model, request_id, data. Each data entry: {id, vector, dims, meta}. meta should include processing_ms and model_version. For single-item calls, SDKs should return a single object (not a list) for ergonomics.
ryan (solutions): Ordering/idempotency: respect input ordering when ids supplied. Return request_id echo and include a per-item status field for partial failures instead of failing the whole batch. If any items fail, include an errors array with {id, code, message}.
anya (cust success): For Private/regulated customers these are blockers: 1) per-tenant quota controls, 2) ability to pin model_version in config, 3) audit logs of embedding requests (who/when/model). We should not GA Private without a pilot customer signed off on those.
kevin (eng-ml): Memory note: 4096 floats ~16KB uncompressed per vector; 4096 dims double memory vs 1536. Recommend shipping quantized artifacts for Dedicated/Private 4096 to reduce footprint. Also propose an auto-batching window = 30ms to balance latency vs throughput.
mohit (eng-platform): Client hinting: add header X-RDW-Embed-Preference: fast|dense so clients can indicate low-latency vs high-quality. Platform autoscaler will try to honor when there is capacity headroom. Also support content negotiation via Accept: application/vnd.rdw.embed+json;version=1.
claire (product): Backcompat: provide a 6-month compatibility path. SDKs will have a legacy_flatten option that returns the old single-array shape. Server will respond with X-RDW-Legacy-Mode when serving compatibility shape.
kevin (eng-ml): Batching caps tradeoffs: larger batches (>1024) improve throughput but increase p99 latency. For GA, cap per-request batch_size at 1024 for hosted and allow tenant override on Dedicated up to operator limit. Also track batch_size histogram in telemetry.
ryan (solutions): SLA targets suggestion: Dedicated p95 <= 120ms for <=32 items; Hosted p95 <= 250ms for <=32 items. Acceptance for GA: perf tests pass with 5 concurrent tenants in staging, end-to-end docs and SDK sample, and one Private pilot.
mohit (eng-platform): Networking note: large-embedding payloads affect ingress. For 4096 dims, estimate ~16KB per vector; we should surface a clear per-request size header limit and reject gracefully with 413 payload too large.
anya (cust success): Add launch checklist item: migration guide + sample transformation code for customers moving from legacy flattened arrays to new per-item objects.
deploy-bot: Staging rollout scheduled for embeddings-api-v1 on Thu 03:00 UTC (canary then broad).
olivia (pm): Owners: Kevin -> model defaults + runtime constraints; Mohit -> platform quotas, headers, and rejection semantics; Claire -> API contract + docs + SDK compatibility; Ryan -> perf tests and SLA validation; Anya -> pilot coordination and customer comms. If there are no major objections I'll lock this and add to the roadmap. :eyes:
